answer_1.quote: We propose a new dataset, named TAT-QA (Tabular And Textual dataset for Question Answering).

answer_2.quote: We adopt the popular Exact Match (EM) and numeracy-focused F1 score to measure model performance on TAT-QA.

answer_4.quote: The human performance is evaluated by asking annotators to answer 50 randomly sampled hybrid contexts (containing 301 questions) from our test set.
